name: Design Resources For Developers
summary: Curated list of design and UI resources from stock photos, web templates, CSS frameworks, UI libraries, tools and much more.

agent_entrypoints.what: The entire list in one markdown file (~150KB). Fetch it and grep the section you need rather than reading it all. Note the lowercase filename.

use_when: You need raw material - a typeface, a photo source, an icon set, a mockup template - not code.
You want inspiration sources to look at before committing to a direction.
You need a chart or animation library and want a shortlist rather than a search engine.
avoid_when: You need opinionated guidance - this is breadth, deliberately unranked.
You need licensing certainty for a linked asset. Always check the destination's own terms before shipping anything from it.

provides.name: Sections
provides.note: UI Graphics, Fonts, Colors, Icons, Logos, Favicons, Icon Fonts, Stock Photos, Stock Videos, Stock Music & Sound Effects, Vectors & Clip Art, Product & Image Mockups, HTML & CSS Templates, CSS Frameworks, CSS Methodologies, CSS Animations, Javascript Animation Libraries, Javascript Chart Libraries, UI Components & Kits, React/Vue/Angular/Svelte/React Native UI Libraries, Design Systems & Style Guides, Online Design Tools, Downloadable Design Software, Design Inspiration, Image Compression, Chrome Extensions, Firefox Extensions, AI Graphic Design Tools, Others.

notes: Links point to third-party sites with their own licenses and terms. The MIT license covers this list, not the resources it links to.
